title: US equity markets closed — Birthday of Martin Luther King, Jr. (the session the January 2028 FOMC blackout loses)
source: NEWS: nyse.com/markets/hours-calendars (redirects to nyse.com/trade/hours-calendars, HTTP 200, 109,180 bytes, fetched direct 2026-09-09 with a browser User-Agent). Its 'Holidays & Trading Hours' table is headed for 2026, 2027 and 2028 and carries the row verbatim, in the page's embedded JSON cell payload: 'Martin Luther King, Jr. Day' | 'Monday, January 19' | 'Monday, January 18' | 'Monday, January 17' — i.e. 2028-01-17. CORROBORATED BY A SECOND PRIMARY RE-FETCHED THE SAME SESSION: federalreserve.gov/aboutthefed/k8.htm (HTTP 200, 82,205 bytes, 'K.8 - Holidays Observed by the Federal Reserve System 2026-2030'), whose 'Birthday of Martin Luther King, Jr.' row reads January 19 / January 18 / January 17 / January 15 / January 21 for 2026-2030, giving January 17 for 2028. Reproduced independently by statute: 5 U.S.C. 6103 fixes the holiday on the THIRD MONDAY IN JANUARY, and January 2028's Mondays are the 3rd, 10th, 17th, 24th and 31st (2028-01-01 is a Saturday, itself corroborated twice — NYSE's 2028 New Year's cell reads '—*' under a footnote that no New Year's holiday is observed in 2028, and K.8's own 2028 New Year's row reads 'January 1*' under the Saturday footnote). WHY STILL ESTIMATE, and it is not doubt about the date: market-events-data.ts's source-prefix taxonomy has no slot for an exchange holiday calendar, which is the same reason every sibling closure entry in this calendar — including the canonical mlk-market-closure-2027-01-18 — is estimate, and this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep. PROMOTION CRITERION, inherited verbatim from the 2027 sibling: an exchange-calendar prefix being added to the taxonomy, or Cboe publishing a 2028 options holiday schedule listing 2028-01-17. Discovered during the fomc-blackout-start-2028-01-15 initial research, checked 2026-09-09
notes: PROPOSED by the fomc-blackout-start-2028-01-15 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-09), at D-490 from that gate's opening. EventKind has no member for an exchange-schedule event, so 'sector' is the least-wrong option rather than a right one — inherited from the mlk-market-closure-2027-01-18 / good-friday-market-closure-2027-03-26 / presidents-day-market-closure-2027-02-15 class. WHY THE PARENT PROPOSES IT: 2028-01-17 is the one closed session INSIDE the 2028-01-15 -> 2028-01-27 FOMC communications blackout, and it is the reason that gate holds eight trading sessions (01-18, 01-19, 01-20, 01-21, 01-24, 01-25, 01-26, 01-27) rather than nine. That is the modal January shape, not an anomaly: 16 of the 21 January gates 2007-2027 contain MLK, because a gate opening ten days before a last-week-of-January meeting almost always spans the third Monday. NOTHING TRADEABLE IS CLAIMED and no re-derivation is attempted of what the 2027 sibling already measured over 1998-2050 — that MLK is one of exactly three US closures structurally locked inside the monthly-expiration window, and that it always falls either three days after January expiration or four days before it. Impact LOW and structural, matching the sibling: a closed session moves nothing by itself, and trade-playbooks.md and multi-symbol-sweep.md were re-grepped this session for blackout|overhang|clean gate|organizational|mega-cap with no calendar-keyed playbook found. BOND SIDE UNSTATED: no SIFMA 2028 panel was read this session, so no fixed-income closure is claimed either way. Proposed as an estimate; estimates widen caution only and nothing here licenses an entry.
